title: 안과에서: 눈이 빨갛고 가려워요
objective: You can describe red, itchy eyes, understand instructions about glasses, lenses and eye drops, and promise with -을게요/-ㄹ게요.
summary: Describe an eye problem at an eye clinic and promise with -을게요/-ㄹ게요.
setting: An eye clinic (안과) in Korea. A patient with red, itchy eyes sees a nurse and then the doctor.

task.title: Practice eye clinic Korean
task.line: Read the dialogue and word list again, then choose, fill in, or write each answer in Korean.

words.exampleMeaning: My eye hurt, so I went to the eye clinic.
I got bitten by a mosquito, so my arm is itchy.
My eyes turned red from crying.
I wear contact lenses when I exercise.

words.example: 아빠는 책을 읽을 때 안경을 써요.
words.exampleMeaning: My dad wears glasses when he reads.
Put in the eye drops and close your eyes for a moment.

dialogue.meaning: Since yesterday my eyes have been red and very itchy.

dialogue.korean: 알레르기 때문에 눈이 빨개졌어요. 렌즈를 끼세요?
dialogue.meaning: Your eyes turned red because of an allergy. Do you wear contact lenses?

dialogue.korean: 네, 매일 껴요. 계속 껴도 돼요?
dialogue.meaning: Yes, every day. Can I keep wearing them?

dialogue.korean: 일주일 동안은 렌즈 대신 안경을 쓰세요. 그리고 눈을 비비지 마세요.
dialogue.meaning: For one week, wear glasses instead of lenses. And don't rub your eyes.
Okay, I'll wear my glasses for a week.
Put in the eye drops four times a day.

exercises: Fill in the blank with -을게요/-ㄹ게요 (넣다): 의사: 이 안약을 하루에 네 번 넣으세요. 환자: 네, 잘 ____.
Choose the right word: 눈이 너무 (가려워서 / 빨개져서) 자꾸 손으로 비벼요.
Choose the right verb: ① 모자를 (껴요 / 써요) ② 렌즈를 (껴요 / 써요) ③ 안약을 (넣어요 / 먹어요)
True or False, based on the dialogue: ① 환자는 오늘 아침부터 눈이 가려웠어요. ② 안약은 하루에 네 번 넣어요. ③ 환자는 렌즈를 끼지 않아요.
Reply to the doctor with a promise, using 끼다 and -을게요/-ㄹ게요: 의사: 일주일 동안 렌즈를 끼지 마세요. 환자: 네, ____.
answers: ① 써요 ② 껴요 ③ 넣어요
① False (어제부터 가려웠어요.) ② True ③ False (매일 껴요.)
